titulo.estudio: Læsning 3 · Fortæller og perspektiv i prosa
titulo.alumno: An omitted explanation · Narrator and perspective in prose

intro: Part 3: an omitted explanation. Compare the two clues and distinguish what the text says from what it only seems to suggest.

texto: In prose, separate who narrates from who perceives. A scene may leave out explanations and let the reader infer a motive from gestures, references and changes of tense.
Compare the two clues and distinguish what the text says from what it only seems to suggest.
